principles_applied.title: Cognitive Load
principles_applied.relevance: The requirements form must keep budget, constraints and tasks understandable while preserving current confirmation semantics.
principles_applied.ai_summary: Group related fields and make the next action and recovery path clear. No universal seven-item limit or conversion improvement is assumed.

principles_applied.title: Error Prevention in Forms
principles_applied.relevance: The current form hides invalid-input and persistence feedback outside its modal.
principles_applied.ai_summary: Show validation and failed-save feedback where users can act on it, retain the draft, and preserve committed requirements until a successful explicit confirmation.

principles_applied.title: Fitts's Law
principles_applied.relevance: Animated controls must remain reachable with stable hit regions and readable state indicators.
principles_applied.ai_summary: Use the project's minimum 48 by 48 dp effective targets and keep visual transforms inside stationary interactive regions.

vibe_coding_prompts.prompt:
You are a React Native frontend engineer implementing an accessible Android requirements form.

Create the first animated needs slice specified by FE-01/02/06/08. Use the project's 48 by 48 dp target requirement and WCAG's 4.5:1 normal-text/3:1 essential-control contrast thresholds as verifiable constraints (https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html and https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-contrast.html). These thresholds do not predict conversion.

Requirements:
- Use the existing Expo SDK 54 / React Native 0.81.5 / TypeScript app, its current Requirements fields and serial store contract.
- Group budget, mandatory specifications and tasks; show one explicit confirmation action and a working Cancel path.
- Use labelled radio choices for single selections and checked multi-select task controls, with visible non-color indicators.
- Display validation and persistence errors inside the active modal; retain the draft, focus the invalid field and announce the error once.
- Share tokens with the preview. Verify compact/expanded windows, IME, Vietnamese text, long VND values and 2.0x font settings.
- Use the shared motion adapter for press/selection and successful confirmation. Keep semantic state immediate and targets stationary.
- Honor reduced-motion changes at startup, during animation and after resume; state commits never depend on animation completion.

Constraints:
- Limit any newly extracted component file to 250 nonblank lines; split focused components/handlers when necessary. This is a maintainability guardrail, not a research threshold.
- Don't modify files outside the active FE task's declared source/config/test scope; preserve unrelated working-tree changes.
- Do not change eligibility, exact price/evidence facts, saved history or confirmed requirements as a visual side effect.

You are a React Native frontend engineer implementing recoverable form interactions.

Create validation, persistence and animation behavior that can be verified through FE-T01/02/09/10. The project's Material acceptance contract requires visible error states, accessible controls of at least 48 dp, and full operability when Android animations are disabled (brd.md AC-UX02–04; https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.81/accessibilityinfo).

Requirements:
- Validate using existing domain boundaries rather than a new UI-only range.
- Handle zero, empty, decimal, excessive and nonnumeric budgets, plus write rejection and retry.
- Keep draft, pending and committed states distinct; accept only one pending confirmation for the same operation.
- Put success/failure acknowledgement on the surface that triggered the action.
- Drive animation from authoritative state; reverse/cancel obsolete motion without firing a business callback.
- Test radio/checkbox semantic state and the no-motion path; use native TalkBack/IME checks for device behavior.

Constraints:
- Keep each newly extracted state-transition handler within 30 nonblank lines by extracting named helpers, without obscuring ordering. This is a maintainability choice.
- Don't modify unrelated files or replace the current AdviserApp with the older demo runtime.
- Never close the form or play committed-success feedback after a failed write.

Create validation, persistence and animation behavior that can be verified through FE-T01/02/09/10. The project's Material acceptance contract requires visible error states, accessible controls of at least 48 dp, and full operability when Android animations are disabled (brd.md AC-UX02–04; https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.81/accessibilityinfo).

UX guardrails:
- The active modal contains its errors and acknowledgement.
- Choices have checked/selected semantics and non-color indicators.
- Targets remain at least 48 by 48 dp while inner visuals animate.
- Draft confirmation and persistence determine truth; motion follows.
- Reduced motion has the same state, evidence and recovery behavior.
ux_guardrails: Keep field and persistence feedback inside the active form or detail surface.
Expose checked/selected state through correct semantics and a non-color indicator.
Keep an effective stationary 48 by 48 dp hit region for interactive controls.
Change confirmed needs only after explicit confirmation and successful persistence, independently of animation callbacks.
Honor motion preferences live and retain equivalent state, feedback, cancellation and focus behavior without movement.
